content.title: Braemar Hotels & Resorts: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: DALLAS (AP) — Braemar Hotels & Resorts, Inc. (BHR) on Thursday reported a key measure of profitability in its second quarter.  The Dallas-based real estate investment trust said it had funds from operations of $6.9 million, or 9 cents per share, in the period.  Funds from operations is a closely watched measure in the REIT industry.
